relations: Gentle surface ripples locally warp the reflected orange canopy and green trees without moving the actual foliage.
A tiny bright speck near center drifts only a few pixels with minor jitter, never crossing the surface.
The two pale vertical marks at lower-left stay fixed in position, varying only in blur as water moves.
Reflection layout remains broadly preserved while each mirrored shape continuously wobbles and breaks up frame to frame.
caption: The video captures a near-still, misty water surface viewed from above, its plane mirroring the surrounding foliage. An orange-brown leafy canopy is reflected across the top, dark-green trees line the right edge, and a broad pale-gray reflection fills the center, with two pale vertical marks at the lower-left. Throughout the excerpt, gentle ripples continuously wobble and deform these reflected shapes rather than the objects themselves. The canopy reflection at the top shifts and breaks up slightly frame to frame, while the green tree reflections on the right ripple and distort. A tiny bright speck sits near the middle of the frame, drifting only a few pixels with minor jitter and never traveling across the surface. The two lower-left marks remain fixed, changing only in slight blur as the water moves. No large-scale translation occurs, and the overall layout of reflections stays preserved.
